verdict_text: NO. Task vector 2 is computed against an already-modified base. The plan adds the scaled `tv1` into `base::h.<i>.<mlp>` before it forms `tv2` by subtracting `base::h.<i>.<mlp>` from the copied `ft2` tensor, so `tv2 = ft2 - (base + 0.4*(ft1 - base))` rather than `ft2 - base`. The result is `base + 0.24*(ft1 - base) + 0.4*(ft2 - base)`, which violates Required result step 2 (each task vector taken against the unmodified base) and will exceed the 1e-5 Frobenius tolerance for the 48 merged tensors. The shared-tensor verification and count checks are otherwise acceptable.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
